title: Ransomware, and the backup that was encrypted along with everything else

videos.script: Ransomware is pictured as one moment: the files are encrypted, a note appears. {{moment}} For whoever recovers, the important part happened weeks earlier. The intruder came in, stayed quietly, and found the backups. {{dwell}} Backups are deleted first, because a victim who can restore does not pay. {{backups}} This lesson is the defender's side. First you watch the log for the shape of damage: a huge amount of change in a few seconds. {{watch}} Then you restore to just before the damage, and the data looks perfect. {{restore}} And you compare the copy with an inventory from a good day. A superuser account came back with the data, created days before. {{audit}} The clean point is before the intruder, not before the damage. And the recovery has an order, which you write down before you need it. {{order}}
